svg.text: verified: checked against the original in the sandbox
library: SDK code, replaced as a unit by Any360
middleware: third-party engine code (physics, AI, video ...): kept or relinked, not rewritten
recompiled: recompiled PowerPC, still to rewrite
Its 317 Xbox system calls, by group
any360: on any360::sys in this title
